title: 新月沙丘熔鹽塔式電廠
summary: 內華達州的新月沙丘電廠是美國第一座、當時世界最大的商用熔鹽塔：淨出力 110 MW，一萬多面定日鏡，十小時儲熱，2015 年開始商轉；但 2016 年熱槽洩漏停機八個月，發電量始終遠低於設計值，2019 年購電合約被終止。課程定量分析設計與實際的落差、停機的收入損失、熱衝擊應力與貸款的年償還額。
summaryEn: Crescent Dunes in Nevada was the first commercial molten-salt tower in the United States and then the world's largest: 110 MW net, over ten thousand heliostats and ten hours of storage, in commercial operation from 2015; but a hot-tank leak in 2016 shut it for eight months, energy stayed far below design, and its power contract was terminated in 2019. The course quantifies the gap between design and reality, revenue lost in the outage, thermal-shock stress and the annual loan payment.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 技術成功、商業失敗的熔鹽塔：設計與實際發電量、熱槽洩漏的損失與償債壓力
v30FocusEn: A molten-salt tower that worked technically and failed commercially: design against actual energy, the cost of a hot-tank leak and debt pressure

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：新月沙丘熔鹽塔式電廠
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Crescent Dunes Molten-Salt Tower Plant
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「設計與實際的發電量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Design against actual energy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Field aperture and annual energy" is correct?
options: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。
陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。
試驗電廠成功了，放大十倍一定也會成功。
optionsEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust.
On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels.
What worked at pilot scale is sure to work ten times larger.
quiz.explanation: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「鏡場面積與年發電量」如何決定「新月沙丘熔鹽塔式電廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Field aperture and annual energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Crescent Dunes Molten-Salt Tower Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 聚光式系統只能利用直達日射（DNI），因此場址必須晴朗乾燥、少雲少塵。年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrating systems use only direct normal irradiance, so sites must be clear, dry and low in cloud and dust. Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：淨出力 110 MW，熔鹽儲熱可供滿載發電 10 小時
steps.observationEn: Project file: It is 110 MW net with molten-salt storage for 10 hours at full load
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「鏡場面積與年發電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Field aperture and annual energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 淨出力 110 MW，熔鹽儲熱可供滿載發電 10 小時
knowledge.textEn: It is 110 MW net with molten-salt storage for 10 hours at full load

quiz.question: 依「鏡場面積與年發電量」的模型 E = DNI·A·η_se，鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = DNI·A·η_se for "Field aperture and annual energy", which value is closest to the annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)?
options: 249 GWh
498 GWh
optionsEn: 249 GWh
498 GWh
quiz.explanation: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2685 kWh/m²、Ah = 1197148 m²、etase = 0.155，得 498 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2685 kWh/m², Ah = 1197148 m², etase = 0.155 the result is 498 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鏡場面積與年發電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Field aperture and annual energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2685 kWh/m²、Ah = 1197148 m²、etase = 0.155，得 498 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 etase 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2685 kWh/m², Ah = 1197148 m², etase = 0.155 the result is 498 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise etase by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 548 GWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 548 GWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 498 GWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 etase 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 498 GWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in etase with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = DNI·A·η_se；代入 DNI = 2685 kWh/m²、Ah = 1197148 m²、etase = 0.155，得 498 GWh（鏡場採光面積對應的年發電量（效率為代表值））。
knowledge.textEn: E = DNI·A·η_se; with DNI = 2685 kWh/m², Ah = 1197148 m², etase = 0.155 the result is 498 GWh (annual energy for the field aperture area (representative efficiency)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: etase 增加 10% 時，結果變為 548 GWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising etase by 10% changes the result to 548 GWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Field aperture and annual energy"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
熱槽只是一個裝鹽的桶子，沒有什麼設計上的難度。
以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A hot tank is just a vessel for salt, with no design difficulty.
Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.
quiz.explanation: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鏡場面積與年發電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Field aperture and annual energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以場內多個日射站的直達日射計（太陽追蹤式）量測 DNI，並以每日能量平衡把各段效率拆開，與設計模型（如 SAM）逐項比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure DNI with tracking pyrheliometers at several stations on site, split daily energy balance into stage efficiencies and compare item by item with a design model such as SAM.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 融資等級的資源評估至少要有一年以上的地面 DNI 量測，並與長期衛星資料做相關校正。
knowledge.textEn: Bankable resource assessment needs at least a year of ground DNI measurement correlated with long-term satellite data.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 62862 太陽熱發電廠標準系列。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 62862 series on solar thermal electric plants. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「鏡場面積與年發電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Field aperture and annual energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
試驗電廠成功了，放大十倍一定也會成功。
optionsEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
What worked at pilot scale is sure to work ten times larger.
quiz.explanation: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鏡場面積與年發電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Field aperture and annual energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鏡場面積與年發電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Field aperture and annual energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「新月沙丘熔鹽塔式電廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Crescent Dunes Molten-Salt Tower Plant”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：年發電量等於年直達日射量、鏡場採光面積與年平均「太陽能—電能」轉換效率的乘積；這個效率把餘弦損失、反射率、遮蔽與阻擋、大氣衰減、吸熱器熱損、儲熱損失與循環效率全部串乘起來，槽式約 14% 至 16%，熔鹽塔式約 15% 至 18%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annual energy is the product of yearly DNI, field aperture area and annual mean solar-to-electric efficiency, which multiplies cosine loss, reflectance, shading and blocking, atmospheric attenuation, receiver loss, storage loss and cycle efficiency: about 14–16% for troughs and 15–18% for molten-salt towers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「陰天時聚光太陽熱電廠和太陽能板一樣，還是可以用散射光發電。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "On cloudy days a concentrating solar plant can still generate from diffuse light like PV panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 場址評估若用衛星推估的 DNI 而未以地面量測校正，氣膠與捲雲的影響被低估，實際年發電量可比預期少一成以上。
knowledge.textEn: A site assessment using satellite-derived DNI without ground calibration underestimates aerosols and cirrus, and actual yield can fall more than a tenth short.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表

knowledge.textEn: 2011: Construction began

quiz.question: 關於「設計與實際的發電量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Design against actual energy" is correct?
options: 試驗電廠成功了，放大十倍一定也會成功。
吸熱器溫度越高越好，沒有任何壞處。
新月沙丘的每一個子系統都曾經運轉過：鏡場能聚光、吸熱器能把鹽加熱到設計溫度、儲熱能讓電廠在夜間發電。
optionsEn: What worked at pilot scale is sure to work ten times larger.
The hotter the receiver the better, with no drawback.
Every subsystem of Crescent Dunes worked at some time: the field concentrated, the receiver heated salt to design temperature, and storage let the plant generate at night.
quiz.explanation: 新月沙丘的每一個子系統都曾經運轉過：鏡場能聚光、吸熱器能把鹽加熱到設計溫度、儲熱能讓電廠在夜間發電。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Every subsystem of Crescent Dunes worked at some time: the field concentrated, the receiver heated salt to design temperature, and storage let the plant generate at night. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設計與實際的發電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Design against actual energy: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「設計與實際的發電量」如何決定「新月沙丘熔鹽塔式電廠」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design against actual energy” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Crescent Dunes Molten-Salt Tower Plant”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 新月沙丘的每一個子系統都曾經運轉過：鏡場能聚光、吸熱器能把鹽加熱到設計溫度、儲熱能讓電廠在夜間發電。但把它們合起來連續可靠地運轉，是另一回事。電廠表現最好的一年，發電量也不到設計值的四成。原因是一連串的設備問題與長時間的停機，而不是原理上的缺陷。對購電的電力公司來說，一座時有時無的電廠沒有多少價值；對放款的機構來說，收入只有預期的三四成就意味著還不出錢。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every subsystem of Crescent Dunes worked at some time: the field concentrated, the receiver heated salt to design temperature, and storage let the plant generate at night. Running them together continuously and reliably was another matter. In its best year the plant generated under four tenths of design. The cause was a run of equipment problems and long outages, not a flaw of principle. To the utility buying power an intermittent plant is worth little, and to lenders revenue at three or four tenths of forecast means debt cannot be paid. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：10,347 面定日鏡，每面約 115.7 m²
steps.observationEn: Project file: It has 10,347 heliostats of about 115.7 m² each
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「試驗電廠成功了，放大十倍一定也會成功。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "What worked at pilot scale is sure to work ten times larger." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「設計與實際的發電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Design against actual energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Every subsystem of Crescent Dunes worked at some time: the field concentrated, the receiver heated salt to design temperature, and storage let the plant generate at night. Running them together continuously and reliably was another matter. In its best year the plant generated under four tenths of design. The cause was a run of equipment problems and long outages, not a flaw of principle. To the utility buying power an intermittent plant is worth little, and to lenders revenue at three or four tenths of forecast means debt cannot be paid.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：試驗電廠成功了，放大十倍一定也會成功。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: What worked at pilot scale is sure to work ten times larger. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 依「設計與實際的發電量」的模型 r = E_a / E_d，表現最好的年度發電量約 196 GWh 相對於設計值 500 GWh 的比例最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model r = E_a / E_d for "Design against actual energy", which value is closest to the best-year energy of about 196 GWh as a share of the design 500 GWh?
quiz.explanation: r = E_a / E_d；代入 Ea = 196 GWh、Ed = 500 GWh，得 39 %（表現最好的年度發電量約 196 GWh 相對於設計值 500 GWh 的比例）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: r = E_a / E_d; with Ea = 196 GWh, Ed = 500 GWh the result is 39 % (best-year energy of about 196 GWh as a share of the design 500 GWh). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 設計與實際的發電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design against actual energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計與實際的發電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Design against actual energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：r = E_a / E_d；代入 Ea = 196 GWh、Ed = 500 GWh，得 39 %（表現最好的年度發電量約 196 GWh 相對於設計值 500 GWh 的比例）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 Ea 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: r = E_a / E_d; with Ea = 196 GWh, Ed = 500 GWh the result is 39 % (best-year energy of about 196 GWh as a share of the design 500 GWh). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise Ea by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：Ea 增加 10% 時，結果變為 43 %（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising Ea by 10% changes the result to 43 % (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 39 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 Ea 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 39 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in Ea with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: r = E_a / E_d；代入 Ea = 196 GWh、Ed = 500 GWh，得 39 %（表現最好的年度發電量約 196 GWh 相對於設計值 500 GWh 的比例）。
knowledge.textEn: r = E_a / E_d; with Ea = 196 GWh, Ed = 500 GWh the result is 39 % (best-year energy of about 196 GWh as a share of the design 500 GWh).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: Ea 增加 10% 時，結果變為 43 %（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising Ea by 10% changes the result to 43 % (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設計與實際的發電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Design against actual energy"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐月比較實際發電量、可用率與日射量，把與設計值的落差分配到各個子系統的停機與降載。
熔鹽儲熱到了隔天早上就幾乎全部散光了。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Monthly energy, availability and irradiation are compared, apportioning the gap from design to outages and derating of each subsystem.
Molten-salt heat is almost entirely lost by the next morning.
quiz.explanation: 逐月比較實際發電量、可用率與日射量，把與設計值的落差分配到各個子系統的停機與降載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Monthly energy, availability and irradiation are compared, apportioning the gap from design to outages and derating of each subsystem. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設計與實際的發電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design against actual energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計與實際的發電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Design against actual energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐月比較實際發電量、可用率與日射量，把與設計值的落差分配到各個子系統的停機與降載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Monthly energy, availability and irradiation are compared, apportioning the gap from design to outages and derating of each subsystem. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：首座放大的電廠要以較低的可用率與較長的學習期做財務規劃，並保留足夠的準備金與備品。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plan finances of a first scaled-up plant on lower availability and a longer learning period, with ample reserves and spares.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把首座放大電廠的發電量假設得和成熟技術一樣可靠，融資結構就沒有留下任何容錯的空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming a first scaled-up plant as reliable as mature technology leaves no margin for error in the financing. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐月比較實際發電量、可用率與日射量，把與設計值的落差分配到各個子系統的停機與降載。
knowledge.textEn: Monthly energy, availability and irradiation are compared, apportioning the gap from design to outages and derating of each subsystem.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 首座放大的電廠要以較低的可用率與較長的學習期做財務規劃，並保留足夠的準備金與備品。
knowledge.textEn: Plan finances of a first scaled-up plant on lower availability and a longer learning period, with ample reserves and spares.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：SolarPACES 定日鏡與反射鏡量測指引。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: SolarPACES guidelines for heliostat and reflectance measurement. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「設計與實際的發電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Design against actual energy" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
吸熱器溫度越高越好，沒有任何壞處。
把首座放大電廠的發電量假設得和成熟技術一樣可靠，融資結構就沒有留下任何容錯的空間。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
The hotter the receiver the better, with no drawback.
Assuming a first scaled-up plant as reliable as mature technology leaves no margin for error in the financing.
quiz.explanation: 把首座放大電廠的發電量假設得和成熟技術一樣可靠，融資結構就沒有留下任何容錯的空間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming a first scaled-up plant as reliable as mature technology leaves no margin for error in the financing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 設計與實際的發電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Design against actual energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設計與實際的發電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Design against actual energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把首座放大電廠的發電量假設得和成熟技術一樣可靠，融資結構就沒有留下任何容錯的空間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「新月沙丘熔鹽塔式電廠」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming a first scaled-up plant as reliable as mature technology leaves no margin for error in the financing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Crescent Dunes Molten-Salt Tower Plant”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對購電的電力公司來說，一座時有時無的電廠沒有多少價值；對放款的機構來說，收入只有預期的三四成就意味著還不出錢。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: To the utility buying power an intermittent plant is worth little, and to lenders revenue at three or four tenths of forecast means debt cannot be paid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「試驗電廠成功了，放大十倍一定也會成功。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "What worked at pilot scale is sure to work ten times larger." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把首座放大電廠的發電量假設得和成熟技術一樣可靠，融資結構就沒有留下任何容錯的空間。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming a first scaled-up plant as reliable as mature technology leaves no margin for error in the financing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
